body.heading: Where in the world is Oman?
paragraphs: Oman is a country in Western Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Oman is Muscat.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Oman is Arabic.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Oman is the Omani rial.

body.heading: How big is Oman?
paragraphs: Oman covers about 310,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Afghanistan.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Muscat spreads white and low between rocky mountains and the sea. Families explore the Mutrah corniche, its frankincense-scented souq and the Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque.
In the Wahiba Sands, golden dunes roll for miles. Families ride camels, visit Bedouin homes and watch for oryx — then sleep under desert stars.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Oman on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Oman in one breath: a country in Western Asia, capital Muscat, where people speak Arabic and pay with the Omani rial.
